# Danny McGiffin — Machinery of Magic

> In the age of AI and commodification, magic is a moat.

Danny works directly with owners of small founder-led businesses to design and build the machinery underneath exceptional customer and employee experiences: business design, standards, decision rights, information systems, workflows, automation, AI, and feedback.
